rationale: Z has the strongest hierarchy and the most specific product visual: a ledger-statement card with a closed stamp, tidy illustrated features, a plan comparison table and consistent spacing. Y has a vivid hero (statement, receipt and note) but looser spacing and a few overlap and clipping rough edges, such as the hero card text and the receipt. X is clean and competent but follows the standard SaaS layout of centred sections, card grids and a stat band, so it is the most template-like.
